name: Los Cerritos Center
description: Los Cerritos Center is a premier two-level enclosed regional shopping mall located in the heart of Cerritos, California, serving the greater Los Angeles area. Featuring anchor stores including Macy's, JCPenney, and Harkins Theatres, this shopping destination offers an extensive mix of popular retailers, dining options, and entertainment venues. The center provides a convenient and comfortable shopping experience with ample parking and modern amenities for the diverse communities of Southeast Los Angeles County.
summary: Los Cerritos Center is a major enclosed regional mall in Cerritos serving the Southeast Los Angeles area with department store anchors, diverse retail, dining, and entertainment options.
